name: Astral Fatigue
description: Overuse of astral channels slows your attacks by 0.01 turn per stack, up to 15. At 15 stacks it erupts as Astral Overdrawn. Lasts 10 turns if not refreshed.

name: Frostburn
description: The cold of the astral gets harsher the more it stacks up

name: Astral Rupture Sparks Stacks
description: Each stack summons one Rupture Spark, up to 30.

name: Frosty Trigger Stacker
description: A volatile astral chill that marks the target with a trace of frost, causing each pulse of astral damage to deepen the frostburn within them.

name: Corruption
description: Corruption builds up over time, weakening the target.
